description:
Hushfeed v0.43.1 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

A packaging fix. No patch changed. The 0.43.0 bundle went out without its patch code, so Morphe Manager showed zero patches for the source. This is the same 91 patches, rebuilt correctly. If you saw no patches on 0.43.0, update the source again.

Validation: 1423 runtime tests passed locally, plus the patches module suite. The bundle carries 91 patches and a non-empty classes.dex, which the release check now requires. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
